principle: GaN Hall channel (DC/LF) + inductive pickup coil (AC) fused by an augmented-state estimator, referenced to machine-current/field-model anchors, zero-field epochs, and (HA tier) an embedded calibration winding

dynamic_range: set by Hall AFE and integrator headroom; clipping detectable only in the overlap band
field_range: tesla-class fusion-machine fields targeted; device-specific limits not yet characterized (unknown)
temperature_limit: unknown for the user's GaN dies until Tier-1 characterization; wide-bandgap family is the design motivation
radiation_evidence: none at architecture level (C06: no in-situ coil-derived Hall-drift identification exists in any fusion/radiation environment); component-level evidence only, and no GaN Hall-plate neutron dataset exists (C14)
drift: differential drift detectable continuously (rho-alarm); common-mode gain drift invisible between anchors (Theorem 1); reported uncertainty grows between anchor epochs
calibration_traceability: bench NMR-class transfer standard + in-situ machine-current/vacuum-field-model anchor (CASE D); embedded winding yields gain products only
vector_capability: extendable (multi-axis dies + coil triads, project-03 path); all stage-20 analysis is single-axis

best_fit: long-pulse/steady-state fusion field monitoring with drift self-diagnostics; stellarator commissioning/mapping niche (C32); calibration-node topology for larger coil arrays
critical_limit: Theorem-1 common-mode blindness between anchors; all calibration value flows from external anchors, not from the pair; unproven as an integrated system
confidence: medium (structure derived and rank-tested in stage 20; system-level performance unproven)

critical_limit: thermal-neutron transmutation is permanent and spectrum-dependent (C12/C24); self-test cannot see common-mode drift (C05)
confidence: high (long operational record + reactor irradiation data, multiple sources)
